queries_run: First Solar manufacturing location geopolitical risk 2026
First Solar supply chain single point of failure polysilicon cadmium telluride
First Solar Malaysia Vietnam India China tariff exposure 2026
solar panel manufacturing supply chain concentration risk China 2026

findings.claim: First Solar 用 CdTe 薄膜技術,不吃矽晶圓/多晶矽那條由中國主導的供應鏈,因此較不受中國關聯的關稅與地緣風險影響
findings.source: pv magazine USA - Solar Manufacturing USA 2026
findings.excerpt: First Solar's CdTe thin-film technology is independent from the silicon-polysilicon value chain dominated by Chinese manufacturers, which insulates it from geopolitical tensions, tariffs, and logistical risks affecting crystalline silicon competitors.

findings.claim: First Solar 的關鍵原料碲(tellurium)是煉銅的副產品,供應量跟著銅需求走;公司只跟少數幾家供應商採購,換供應商要走很長的資格審查,萬一斷供不容易及時補上
findings.source: First Solar 10-K (FY2015) 風險因子章節
findings.excerpt: First Solar currently purchases these raw materials from a limited number of suppliers, and because suppliers must undergo a lengthy qualification process, the company may be unable to replace a lost supplier in a timely manner and on commercially reasonable terms.

findings.claim: First Solar 產能刻意集中在美國本土(Ohio、Alabama、Louisiana),2026 Q1 美國廠稼動率 96%,出貨 3.8GW,公司稱這樣的本土集中讓自己不受全球地緣風險波動影響
findings.source: pv magazine USA - Solar Manufacturing USA 2026
findings.excerpt: This deliberate concentration in Ohio, Alabama, and Louisiana creates a domestic industrial base optimized for serving large utility-scale projects and insulated from global geopolitical volatility.

findings.claim: 因美國政策不確定性、中國模組流入歐洲、印度關稅政策等近期逆風,First Solar 宣布 2025 年把馬來西亞、越南廠的 Series 6 模組產能下修 1GW,重心轉向美國本土擴產
findings.excerpt: These items create near-term headwinds for our international production

findings.claim: 截至 2025 年底前後,美國對越南(20%)、印度(25%)、馬來西亞(19%)課對等關稅;印度另以反傾銷/核准名單機制,大幅堵住中國電池模組借道東南亞轉銷印度的路
findings.source: SurgePV - Solar Import Duty Rates by Country
findings.excerpt: Reciprocal tariff rates apply to Vietnam (20%), India (25%), and Malaysia (19%) as of late 2025. Additionally, India's tariff and non-tariff measures against Chinese cells and modules have largely eliminated the country as a destination from Malaysia and Vietnam product, including India's Basic Customs Duty and the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers.

geo_supply_chain.note: 查到 FSLR 用 CdTe 技術避開矽晶多晶矽的中國供應鏈,但碲原料供應商集中、東南亞廠(馬來西亞/越南)受關稅擠壓、公司正把重心收回美國本土三州。碲供應商集中的原文出自 2015 年 10-K,較舊,無法確認 2026 年最新版措辭是否相同;2026 FY1 10-Q 的風險因子章節內文未能透過 WebFetch 取得逐字原文。
